items.source: This class includes a Media.Format inner class that provides commonly used MIME types as constants, organized by content category (documents, videos, images). These formats can be used when constructing Media objects to ensure correct MIME type specification.
items.translation: 该类包含一个 Media.Format 内部类，该内部类按内容类别（文档、视频、图像）组织常用的 MIME 类型常量。在构建 Media 对象时，可以使用这些格式来确保正确指定 MIME 类型。

items.source: If no name is provided, one will be automatically generated using the pattern: {mimeType.subtype}-{UUID}
items.translation: 如果未提供名称，将自动生成一个名称，模式如下： {mimeType.subtype}-{UUID}

items.source:
Media objects can be used in the UserMessage class to attach various types of content
like images, documents, or videos. When interacting with AI models, the id and name
fields help track and reference specific media objects.
items.translation: Media 对象可用于 UserMessage 类中，以附加各种类型的内容，如图像、文档或视频。在与 AI 模型交互时，id 和 name 字段有助于跟踪和引用特定的媒体对象。

items.source:
The id field is typically assigned by AI models when they reference previously provided
media.
items.translation: id 字段通常由 AI 模型在引用先前提供的媒体时分配。

items.source:

care should be taken to avoid prompt injection vulnerabilities. For amazon AWS the name

items.source:
The Media class represents the data and metadata of a media attachment in a message. It
consists of a MIME type, raw data, and optional metadata such as id and name.
items.translation: Media 类表示消息中媒体附件的数据和元数据。它由 MIME 类型、原始数据以及可选的元数据（如 id 和名称）组成。

items.source:
